models_evaluated: three locally deployed open-weight LLMs (unnamed in abstract)

links.outcome: Inter-rater agreement among clinician annotators using rubric on benchmark labels
links.effect: Inter-rater agreement was 98.8% across the full benchmark (Cohen's κ = 0.976) and 94.0% within the ambiguous subset (κ = 0.880).
links.quote: Inter-rater agreement was 98.8% across the full benchmark (Cohen’s κ = 0.976) and 94.0% within the intentionally ambiguous subset (κ = 0.880).

unlisted_practices: Clinician-guided synthetic benchmark development for detecting stigmatizing language in clinical documentation

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates a synthetic benchmark (ClinStigma-SUD) to measure LLM detection of contextual stigmatizing language in clinical documentation, but it does not test a specific deployment safeguard or operational practice.
